name: 黑棺
description: 灵压。对5格内1名敌人造成150%攻击力的魔法伤害并使其无法移动；目标下回合结束时再次造成等量伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 5, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.floor(caster.attack * 1.5); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'magical', battle, 'aizen-black-coffin'); var living = battle.pieces.find(function(piece) { return piece.instanceId === target.instanceId && piece.currentHp > 0; }); if (living) { addStatusEffectById(living.instanceId, { id: 'aizen-black-coffin-' + caster.instanceId + '-' + living.instanceId, type: 'imprisoned', name: '禁锢', visible: true, currentDuration: 1, currentUses: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: caster.instanceId, delayedDamage: damage, blocksForcedMovement: true }); addRuleById(living.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-move'); addRuleById(living.instanceId, 'rule-aizen-black-coffin-end'); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '以黑棺造成' + (result.damage || 0) + '点魔法伤害' }; }
